@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: 'Close the double-check items: gated router pool, stale poolLock comment, §2.6 wording, gated run at the fork pin'
+---
+Found by the holistic double-check of branch `pool` (2026-09-05). Four small items in one card.
+
+## What
+1. `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterIntegrationTests/IntegrationTests.swift`: the `Router(` construction near line 325 names no pool, so that gated suite resolves into `ModelPool.shared`, and its `await profile.release()` near line 485 is the last statement, not a `defer`. Add `pool: ModelPool()` to that `Router(` call, and move the release into a `defer` at the top of the test body so a thrown `try` still frees the real models at once.
+2. `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/PooledResidencyTests.swift`, the doc comment of `releaseCannotRaceAnInFlightResolveAndCorruptAccounting` near line 572 names `poolLock`, which no longer exists. Say that ``ModelPool/withResolveLock(isolation:_:)`` guards `ModelPool.release(token:)` as well as `Router.resolve(profile:reporting:)`.
+3. `model-pool.md` §2.6: `.gitignore` ignores both `Package.resolved` files and both manifests take the fork by `branch: "stable"`, so "bump `Package.resolved` here" cannot be a tracked change. Rewrite the last sentence of §2.6 to say the pin is local, that a fresh clone resolves the tip of `stable`, and that a tracked guarantee needs either a `revision:` pin in both manifests or an un-ignored `Package.resolved`. Do not change the manifests in this card.
+4. Run the full gated suite one time at the current fork pin (`fd8de95` in both checkouts) and record the counts as a comment on card `^44z4s00` and on this card. The last gated run was at pin `18ddcd1`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `rg -n 'Router\(' IntegrationTests/Tests` shows a `pool:` argument at the `IntegrationTests.swift` construction.
+- [ ] `rg -n poolLock Tests Sources` finds nothing.
+- [ ] §2.6 of `model-pool.md` states the local-pin fact.
+- [ ] Card `^44z4s00` carries the gated counts at `fd8de95`.
+- [ ] `swift test` green; `swift build --package-path IntegrationTests --build-tests` exit 0; `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests` green.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `swift test` → all pass.
+- [ ] `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests` → all pass, counts recorded.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` where a test applies; items 2 and 3 are text only. #model-pool #cleanup
\ No newline at end of file
